title: StockSmart Supply Desk Questions — Backorders and Further Lead Days on a Converted Bin
content:
**Rule.** For the customer-owned reorder point of a StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program bin converted from consignment at a par review, backorders of the converted item opened at the program's ship-to in the last three months add further lead days: where more were opened than were filled or cancelled in those months, 2 days; where some were opened and as many or more were filled or cancelled in those months, 1 day; where none was opened, none.

**Q. Where are backorders read?** On the order history of the program's ship-to, held as a Ship-To Fulfillment Account: backorder lines of the converted item opened, filled and cancelled.

**Q. What are the last three months?** Rows of age below three, a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month.

**Q. Hypothetically, 3 opened and 2 filled in the window?** More opened than closed: 2 days.

**Q. 2 opened, 1 filled and 1 cancelled?** As many closed as opened: 1 day.

**Q. None opened, though an older backorder was filled in the window?** None was opened: nothing is added.
